from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/agent/threads")

class MemoryUpdatePayload(BaseModel):
    memory_value: dict

@router.put("/{thread_id}/memories/{memory_key}")
async def update_thread_memory(
    thread_id: str,
    memory_key: str,
    payload: MemoryUpdatePayload,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    memory_store: AgentMemoryStore = Depends(get_memory_store),
    thread_manager: ThreadManager = Depends(get_thread_manager)
):
    thread = await thread_manager.get_thread(thread_id=thread_id)
    if not thread or thread.owner_id != current_user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Thread not found")

    await memory_store.aput(
        namespace=(thread_id, "memories"),
        key=memory_key,
        value=payload.memory_value
    )
    return {
        "status": "stored",
        "thread_id": thread_id,
        "memory_key": memory_key
    }
